info.title: FixMyScan API
info.description:
Turn scanned books (PDF or DjVu, up to 1,000 pages) into clean, searchable
PDFs for e-readers: pages cropped to the text, straightened, sharp black and white
or gentle greyscale, two-page spreads split, searchable text added.

**Keys.** Make one on your FixMyScan Account page and send it as
`Authorization: Bearer fms_live_...`. It is shown once.

**Flow.** `POST /uploads`, PUT the file, then `POST /books` with the `upload_id`
(or `POST /books` with a `source_url`). Poll `GET /books/{id}` or give a
`webhook_url`. Files are deleted 24 hours after a book is ready.

**Webhooks.** One POST when a book ends, `book.ready` or `book.failed`, with the
book as `data`. Check `FixMyScan-Signature: t=<time>,v1=<hex>`: HMAC-SHA256 of
`"<t>.<raw body>"` with the webhook secret shown beside your key. Retried after
30 s, 2 min, 10 min, 1 h and 6 h until your endpoint answers 2xx.

**Errors.** `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}`; a 402 adds `upgrade_url`,
and `allowance` (`pages_left`, `renews_at`) when free pages come back on a date.

post.description:
Make a book and a presigned upload for its file (PDF or DjVu, up to 1 GB
and 1,000 pages). PUT the bytes to `upload.url` with `upload.headers`, then
start it with POST /v1/public/books and the `upload_id`.

401.description: No API key, or one that was deleted.

402.description: The book cannot start: no free pages left and no plan. See upgrade_url, and allowance.renews_at for when free pages come back.

404.description: No such book for this key's account.

409.description: The book is in a state that does not allow this.

429.description: Too many requests for this key. Wait for Retry-After seconds.

post.description:
Convert a scan from `source_url` or an `upload_id`. Answers at once; the
book converts in the background (minutes). Poll GET /v1/public/books/{id},
or give a `webhook_url`. Without a plan, a book converts from the account's
free allowance, and a book longer than what is left converts its first pages
(`first_pages_only`). Free pages come back every 30 days. With none left the
answer is 402 with `upgrade_url` and `allowance.renews_at`.

state.title: State
state.description: awaiting_upload, inspecting, ready_for_crop, awaiting_authorization, queued, processing, validating, ready, failed, refused, cancelled or expired.

message.title: Message
message.description: One plain sentence about the book, for people.

pages_total.title: Pages Total
pages_total.description: Pages this conversion makes (fewer than pages for a first-pages book).

first_pages_only.title: First Pages Only
first_pages_only.description: True when only the book's first pages are converted, from the free pages; pages_total says how many.

allowance.description: The account's free pages in the rolling 30 days, once they are counting; null with a plan.

download_url.title: Download Url
download_url.description: The finished PDF while it exists; the link works for an hour.

upgrade_url.title: Upgrade Url
upgrade_url.description: Where a plan can be bought, when the book was refused.

trim_margins.title: Trim Margins
trim_margins.description: Crop each page to its text block. Covers and picture pages stay whole.

split_spreads.title: Split Spreads
split_spreads.description: Split scans of two facing pages into single pages.

output.title: Output
output.description: bw: sharp black and white, best on e-ink. grey: gentle greyscale.

language.title: Language
language.description: Tesseract code of the book's language (eng, deu, lat...), or auto to detect it.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: A public https link to the PDF or DjVu file.

webhook_url.title: Webhook Url
webhook_url.description: https URL posted once when the book is ready or failed.

pages_left.title: Pages Left
pages_left.description: Free pages left in the rolling 30 days.

renews_at.title: Renews At
renews_at.description: When the oldest counted pages come back; null while none are used.

images.title: Images
images.description: before and after: JPEG links that work for an hour.

upload_id.title: Upload Id
upload_id.description: Pass it to POST /v1/public/books (or /previews) after the PUT.

upload.description: PUT the file's bytes to url with these headers, within the hour.

size.title: Size
size.description: The file's exact size in bytes; the upload URL is signed for it.
